name: SMA
description: This keyword returns the simple moving average of any period of any selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the simple moving average of any period of any selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632219280.png)

You can plot SMA on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot SMA of RSI, OPEN etc

A simple moving average is a technical indicator that can aid in determining if an asset price will continue or if it will reverse a bull or bear trend.

Read more about SMA here -  https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/sma.asp
